reasoning: For L[x]=x′−Ax, linearity gives L[2x₁+xₚ]=f, L[x₁−x₂]=0, and L[3xₚ]=3f. Thus only I always solves the system with forcing f; II and III work only when f is identically zero. Choice c agrees with Math Academy's stated answer.

answers.ma_evidence: Therefore, the correct answer is "I only".
